blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Online vectorized HD map construction is essential for scaling safe autonomous driving and requires accurate, real-time inference. Prior methods typically rely on dense bird’s-eye-view (BEV) grids as the intermediate representation. We propose MapLightning , which replaces the dense BEV grid with a compact set of 1D learnable map tokens. To construct map tokens from image features, we choose self-attention over vanilla cross-attention because it enables joint interactions and contextual aggregation among image and map tokens. Our transformer-based mapper concatenates map and image tokens, applies full self-attention, discards the image tokens, and retains the updated map tokens for decoding. This design offers three advantages. First, our representation is efficient, using fewer tokens, consuming less memory, and running faster. Second, the lightweight design allows the map decoder to use full rather than deformable cross-attention for better global context. Third, unlike BEV-based methods, our network does not use camera projection parameters, making it robust to camera-extrinsic perturbations. MapLightning uses up to 16.7 × \times fewer intermediate tokens than dense BEV-based methods and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and efficiency on nuScenes and Argoverse 2. Its lightweight variant surpasses MapTRv2 by +10.1 mAP on nuScenes and +16.2 mAP on Argoverse 2, while delivering 1.73 × \times faster inference (40+ FPS) with 53% less memory. We further show improvements on uncertainty-aware map construction and downstream trajectory prediction. Code and models will be released.
blocks.zh: 在线矢量化 HD地图的构建对于扩大安全自主驾驶至关重要,需要准确,实时的推断. 先前的方法通常依靠密集的鸟眼视网格作为中间代表。 我们提议使用1D可学习地图符号的紧凑组合取代密集的BEV网格。 为了从图像特性构建地图符号,我们选择自我注意而不是香草交叉注意,因为它能够使图像符号和地图符号之间进行联合互动和背景汇总。 我们基于变压器的映射器将映射图和图像符号组合起来,充分应用自觉,丢弃图像符号,保留更新的映射符号进行解码. 这种设计有三个优点. 首先,我们的代表效率高,使用较少的符号,消耗较少的记忆,运行得更快. 第二,轻量级设计使地图解码器能够使用完整的而非可变形的交叉意向来改善全球环境. 第三,与基于BEV的方法不同的是,我们的网络不使用相机投影参数,使得它坚固到相机-exrinsic 扰动. MapLightning使用最多为16.7×x\times的中间符号比密集的基于BEV的方法更少,并在nuScees和Argoverse上实现最先进的精度和效率. 2. 其轻量级变体在nuScenes上通过+10.1 mAP超越MapTRv2,在argoverse 2上通过+16.2 mAP超越MapTRv2,同时提供1.73×\时速更快的推论(40+FPS),内存减少53%. 我们进一步显示,在对不确定性认识的地图构建和下游轨迹预测方面有所改进。 将发布代码和模型。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: High-definition (HD) maps provide centimeter-level vectorized representations of static road elements such as lane dividers, pedestrian crossings, and road boundaries. These elements encode road topology and driving constraints essential for autonomous navigation. Traditionally, HD maps are constructed offline using SLAM- or SfM-based pipelines ( Zhang et al., 2014 ; Shan and Englot, 2018 ; Zhanabatyrova et al., 2024 ) , requiring expensive annotation and maintenance.
blocks.zh: 高清晰度(HD)地图提供了诸如车道划分器、行人过境和道路边界等静态道路要素的厘米级矢量表示。 这些要素编码了道路地形和对自主航行至关重要的驾驶限制。 传统上,HD地图是使用基于SLAM-或SfM的管道线下构造的(Zhang等人,2014年;Shan and Englot,2018年;Zhanabatyrova等人,2024年),需要昂贵的注释和维护.

blocks.en: Recently, online vectorized HD map construction ( Liao et al., 2022 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Liao et al., 2025 ; Dong et al., 2025 ; Monninger et al., 2026 ) has gained popularity by building local maps at runtime from onboard sensors, reducing reliance on costly offline map construction and maintenance. Online vectorized HD map construction methods typically follow a three-stage pipeline: an image encoder extracts features from surround-view images, a bird’s-eye-view (BEV) projection module such as LSS ( Philion and Fidler, 2020 ) or BEVFormer ( Li et al., 2024b ) projects them into a dense BEV grid, and a DETR-style ( Carion et al., 2020 ) decoder with deformable attention ( Zhu et al., 2020 ) predicts map elements as ordered point sets.
blocks.zh: 最近,在线矢量HD地图建设(廖等,2022年;袁等,2024年;陈等,2024年;廖等,2025年;董等,2025年;孟宁杰等,2026年)通过从机载传感器在运行时间绘制本地地图,减少了对昂贵的离线地图建设和维护的依赖,获得了人们的欢迎. 在线矢量HD地图构建方法一般遵循三阶段管道:图像编码器从环景图像中提取特征,鸟眼视(BEV)投影模块,如LSS(Philion and Fidler,2020年)或BEVFormer(Li等人,2024年b)将其投影成密集的BEV网格,以及DETR式(Carion等人,2020年)可变形的解码器(Zhu等人,2020年)预测地图元素为定点集.

blocks.en: The BEV-based design is effective for dense spatial perception tasks like semantic segmentation ( Philion and Fidler, 2020 ; Zhou and Krähenbühl, 2022 ) and 3D occupancy prediction ( Yu et al., 2023 ; Hou et al., 2024 ) , where dense spatial prediction naturally aligns with the BEV grid. However, it is less suited for vectorized map prediction, where the output is a sparse set of vectorized map elements that occupy only 4.27% of the rasterized perception range on nuScenes ( Caesar et al., 2020 ) and 2.65% on Argoverse 2 ( Wilson et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 基于BEV的设计对于语义分化(Philion and Fidler, 2020年;Zhou and Krähenbühl, 2022年)和3D占用预测(Yu等人, 2023年;Hou等人, 2024年)等密集空间感知任务是有效的,密度空间预测与BEV网格自然吻合. 然而,它不太适合用于矢量化地图预测,因为产出是一组稀少的矢量化地图元素,它们只占nuScenes(Caesar等人,2020年)和Argoverse 2(Wilson等人,2023年)上光泽感知范围的4.27%。

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose to use 1D learnable tokens, which we call map tokens , as the intermediate scene representation. This design offers three key advantages. (i) Our representation uses fewer intermediate tokens, consumes less memory, and runs faster. (ii) The lightweight design allows the map decoder to use full attention instead of deformable attention, giving each query access to the entire representation for better global context and long-range dependencies. (iii) Unlike BEV-based methods, ours does not use camera projection parameters, making it robust to extrinsic perturbations.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提议使用我们称之为地图符号的1D可学习符号作为中间场景代表. 这种设计提供了三大优势. (一)我们的代表使用较少的中间符号,消耗较少的内存,运行更快. (二)轻量级设计使地图解码器能够使用充分的注意而不是变形的注意,让每个查询访问到整个代表处,以更好的全局背景和远程依赖性. (三) 与基于BEV的方法不同的是,我们的不使用相机投影参数,使其坚固到外部扰动.

blocks.en: Constructing map tokens requires compressing a large number of multi-view image tokens into a much smaller set, and the choice of compression mechanism is critical. Specifically, we concatenate map and image tokens and apply attention over the joint sequence. As shown in Figure 1 , we adopt self-attention instead of vanilla cross-attention, since vanilla cross-attention only lets map tokens read from image tokens, whereas self-attention also allows explicit image-to-image and map-to-map token interactions for richer contextual aggregation. The image-to-image interactions are particularly useful for refining visual context: as illustrated in Figure 3 , self-attention progressively concentrates on map-relevant structures across layers. After the final mapper layer, the image tokens are discarded, leaving compact map tokens that retain the aggregated map-relevant information. These map tokens serve as the intermediate representation for the decoder. In the decoder, cross-attention is used because the map queries act as output slots that read from the fixed map-token representation, similar to decoding objects ( Carion et al., 2020 ) or categories ( Strudel et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 构建地图符号需要将大量多视图图像符号压缩成一个更小的集,压缩机制的选择至关重要. 具体地说,我们把地图和图像符号整合起来,并将注意力放在联合序列上。 如图1所示,我们采用自我注意而不是香草交叉注意,因为香草交叉注意只允许从图像符号读取映像符号,而自我注意也允许清晰的图像到图像和映像到映像符号交互,以进行更丰富的背景聚合. 图像对图像的相互作用对改进视觉环境特别有用:如图3所示,自觉性逐渐集中于跨层的地图相关结构. 在最后映射层后,图像符被丢弃,留下了保留汇总地图相关信息的紧凑的映射符. 这些地图符号作为解码器的中间代表. 在解码器中,使用交叉切入,因为地图查询作为输出槽,从固定的映射符号读取,类似于解码对象(Carion等人,2020年)或类别(Strudel等人,2021年).

blocks.en: Figure 1: Aggregating multi-view image tokens into a scene representation. (a) BEV-based methods ( Liao et al., 2022 ; Liao et al., 2025 ) geometrically project image features onto a dense grid of fixed BEV cells, few of which contain map elements. (b) Vanilla cross-attention compresses image tokens into compact map tokens, but image tokens serve only as fixed keys and values, with no image-to-image or map-to-map interaction. (c) Self-attention (ours, Section 3.3 ) attends over the concatenated map and image tokens, refining all tokens jointly. Gray and violet edges denote image–map and intra-group attention, respectively. In the masks, rows are queries, columns are keys/values, shaded cells mark allowed attention, and M \mathrm{M} / I \mathrm{I} denote map/image tokens. See Table 1 for comparison.
blocks.zh: 图 1:将多视图图像符号聚合成场景代表. (a) 基于BEV的方法(Liao等人,2022年;Liao等人,2025年),几何项目图像特征在固定BEV细胞的密集网格上,其中很少包含地图元素. (b) 香草横切将图像符号压缩成紧凑的地图符号,但图像符号仅作为固定的键和值,没有图像到图像或地图到地图的交互作用. (c) 自觉(我们,第3.3节)出席装饰的地图和图像标志,共同改进所有标志。 灰边和紫边分别表示图像图和组内注意. 在口罩中,行为查询,列为密钥/值,阴影单元格标记允许注意,M\mathrm{M}/I\mathrm{I}表示地图/图像符号. 比较见表1。

blocks.en: We name our framework MapLightning for its fast inference, token-efficient design, and high accuracy. By replacing the dense BEV grid with a compact set of tokens (up to 16.7 × \times fewer), MapLightning achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and efficiency on nuScenes and Argoverse 2. With a lightweight MobileNetV3-Large backbone, it surpasses MapTRv2 ( Liao et al., 2025 ) by +10.1 and +16.2 mAP on nuScenes and Argoverse 2, running 1.73 × \times faster ( 40+ FPS ) with 53% less memory.
blocks.zh: 我们命名我们的地图照明框架 因为它的快速推论, 象征性的高效设计, 和高精度。 MapLightning通过将密集的BEV网格替换为一套紧凑的代号(最多减少16.7×\时),在nuScenes和Argoverse上实现了最先进的精度和效率. 2. 拥有轻量级的MobileNetV3-Large主干线,在nuScenes和Argoverse 2上以+10.1和+16.2 mAP超越了MapTRv2(Liao等人,2025年),运行速度快1.73×\时间(40+FPS),内存减少53%.

blocks.en: In summary, the main contributions of this paper are: • We propose MapLightning, the first online vectorized HD map construction framework that replaces dense BEV projection with attention-based mapping into compact 1D map tokens, yielding higher efficiency, better global context, and robustness to extrinsic perturbations. • We compare cross-attention and self-attention for constructing map tokens from image features, and show that self-attention is more effective for online vectorized HD map construction. • MapLightning outperforms prior methods on online vectorized HD map construction, uncertainty-aware map construction, downstream trajectory prediction, and 3D object detection.
blocks.zh: 总之,本文件的主要贡献是: 我们提议采用MapLightning,这是第一个在线矢量化的HD地图构建框架,它将密集的BEV投影换成以注意力为主的绘图成紧凑的1D地图符号,从而产生更高的效率、更好的全球环境以及强健的外部扰动。 我们比较从图像特性中构建地图符号的交叉意向和自我意向,显示自我意向对在线矢量HD地图构建更有效. • 地图照明在在线矢量化的HD地图构建、不确定性-意识地图构建、下游轨迹预测和3D物体探测方面,其前期方法已超过预期。

blocks.en: We propose MapLightning, the first online vectorized HD map construction framework that replaces dense BEV projection with attention-based mapping into compact 1D map tokens, yielding higher efficiency, better global context, and robustness to extrinsic perturbations.
blocks.zh: 我们提议使用MapLightning作为第一个在线矢量化的HD地图构建框架,将密集的BEV投影换成以注意力为本的绘图成紧凑的1D地图符号,产生更高的效率,更好的全球背景,以及强健的外在扰动.

blocks.en: We compare cross-attention and self-attention for constructing map tokens from image features, and show that self-attention is more effective for online vectorized HD map construction.
blocks.zh: 我们比较从图像特性中构建地图符号的交叉意向和自我意向,显示自我意向对在线矢量HD地图构建更有效.

blocks.en: MapLightning outperforms prior methods on online vectorized HD map construction, uncertainty-aware map construction, downstream trajectory prediction, and 3D object detection.
blocks.zh: MapLightning在在线矢量化HD地图构建,不确定性-意识地图构建,下游轨迹预测,3D物体检测方面,前期方法都超标.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Online Vectorized HD Map Construction
blocks.zh: 2.1 在线矢量HD地图建设

blocks.en: Most online vectorized HD map construction methods follow a MapTR-style ( Liao et al., 2022 ) framework with dense BEV representations and a DETR-style decoder ( Liu et al., 2023b ; Liao et al., 2022 ; Liao et al., 2025 ) . Follow-up works refine the decoder, supervision, and temporal modeling within this paradigm ( Yuan et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Dong et al., 2025 ; Monninger et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 大多数在线矢量化的HD地图构建方法都遵循MapTR风格(廖等人,2022年)框架,具有密集的BEV表示和DETR风格的解码器(刘等人,2023b;廖等人,2022年;廖等人,2025年). 后续工作完善了这一范式中的解码器,监督和时间模型(袁等人,2024年;陈等人,2024年;董等人,2025年;孟宁杰等人,2026年).

blocks.en: Our approach differs from prior online vectorized HD map construction methods in two key aspects: (i) Instead of following the conventional dense BEV paradigm, we compress image tokens into compact 1D map tokens using attention, achieving higher efficiency and accuracy. (ii) Unlike many previous methods that focus on map construction alone, we show that our representation benefits downstream trajectory prediction and generalizes to 3D object detection.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法在两个关键方面与先前的在线矢量HD地图构建方法不同:(一)我们不是遵循传统的密集BEV范式,而是利用注意力将图像符号压缩成紧凑的1D地图符号,实现更高的效率和准确性. (二)与以往许多仅注重地图构造的方法不同,我们显示我们的表示法有利于下游的轨迹预测,并概括到3D物体探测.

blocks.en: 2.2 Beyond BEV-Based Representation
blocks.zh: 2.2 超越BEV代表制

blocks.en: BEV representations have been widely adopted for dense spatial perception. For example, Lift-Splat-Shoot ( Philion and Fidler, 2020 ) and Cross-View Transformers ( Zhou and Krähenbühl, 2022 ) construct BEV features for semantic segmentation, whereas FlashOcc ( Yu et al., 2023 ) and FastOcc ( Hou et al., 2024 ) extend this representation to 3D occupancy prediction.
blocks.zh: BEV表示法被广泛用于密集的空间感知. 例如,Fellow-Splate-Shoot(Philion and Fidler, 2020)和跨视变形器 (Zhou and Krähenbühl, 2022 )为语义分裂构建了BEV特征,而FlashOcc(Yu等人, 2023 )和FastOcc(Hou等人, 2024 )则将这种表示扩展为3D占用预测.

blocks.en: Works on sparse prediction have explored removing BEV as an intermediate representation by aggregating image features into task queries. In 3D object detection, SparseBEV ( Liu et al., 2023a ) achieves performance comparable to dense-BEV methods like BEVFormer v2 ( Yang et al., 2023 ) . In online vectorized HD map construction, SparseMeXt ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) follows a similar direction but underperforms dense-BEV methods like MapTRv2 ( Liao et al., 2025 ) in comparable settings.
blocks.zh: 通过将图像特征汇总到任务查询中,关于稀疏预测的工作探索了将BEV作为中间代表的去除. 在3D对象检测中,SparseBEV(Liu等人,2023a)的性能与BEVFORmer v2(Yang等人,2023年)等密集BEV方法相当. 在在线矢量HD地图构建中,SparseMeXt(Jiang等人,2025年)遵循了相似的方向,但表现不佳的密度-BEV方法,如MapTRv2(Liao等人,2025年)在类似环境下.

blocks.en: Unlike prior methods that either retain BEV-based feature projection or drop the intermediate representation, we use 1D learnable map tokens as a compact and performant intermediate representation.
blocks.zh: 与以前保留基于BEV的特性投影或降低中间代表的方法不同,我们使用1D可学习的地图符号作为紧凑和表现的中间代表.

blocks.en: 2.3 Compressing Tokens via Attention Mechanisms
blocks.zh: 2.3 通过注意机制压缩托肯

blocks.en: Learned query tokens are a common pattern for pooling a large set of input tokens via cross-attention. Queries can decode specific outputs, such as object predictions ( Carion et al., 2020 ) or slots that explain an image ( Locatello et al., 2020 ; Vani et al., 2024 ) . Queries can also compress tokens into a smaller bottleneck for further processing, as in Perceiver’s latents ( Jaegle et al., 2021 ; Jaegle et al., 2022 ) , Flamingo’s resampler ( Alayrac et al., 2022 ) , and Q-Former ( Li et al., 2023a ) .
blocks.zh: 学到的查询符是一种常见的模式,通过交叉意向将一大批输入符集中起来. 查询可以解码特定输出,如物体预测(Carion等人,2020年)或解释图像的槽(Locallo等人,2020年;Vani等人,2024年). 查询还可以将信条压缩成一个较小的瓶颈,供进一步处理,如Perceiver的潜伏物(Jaegle等人,2021年;Jaegle等人,2022年),Flamingo的复标器(Alayrac等人,2022年)和Q-Former(Li等人,2023年a) 。 。 。

blocks.en: Learned tokens can also aggregate information through self-attention by being concatenated with input tokens and jointly updated within the same sequence, which most closely resembles our design. Such tokens have been explored in general representation learning and sequence modeling, including the [CLS] token in BERT ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) , memory tokens ( Burtsev et al., 2020 ) , the [CLS] token in ViT ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2021 ) , gist tokens ( Mu et al., 2023 ) , summary vectors ( Chevalier et al., 2023 ) , register tokens in Registers ( Darcet et al., 2024 ) , and planning tokens in Flex ( Yang et al., 2025a ) . They have also been used in dense or generative tasks, such as latent tokens in LVSM ( Jin et al., 2024 ) and light tokens in RelitLRM ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 学到的符号还可以通过自觉通过与输入符号的配合和在同一序列内联合更新来汇总信息,这与我们的设计最相似. 在一般的表达学习和序列建模中探索了这种标志,包括BERT中的[CLS]标志(Devlin等人,2019年),记忆标志(Burtsev等人,2020年),Vit中的[CLS]标志(Dosovitskiy等人,2021年),吉祥标志(Mu等人,2023年),即时矢量(Chevalier等人,2023年),注册标志(Darcet等人,2024年),以及Flex中的规划标志(Yang等人,2025a年). 它们也被用于密集或遗传性的任务,例如LVSM(Jin等人,2024年)中的潜在信使和RelitLRM(Zhang等人,2025年)中轻型信使.

blocks.en: Unlike previous works targeting dense or general-purpose perception, we apply attention-based token compression to the sparse task of online vectorized HD map construction with a tailored mapper.
blocks.zh: 与以往针对稠密或通用感知的作品不同,我们将基于关注的符号压缩应用于使用定制的映射器进行在线矢量化HD地图构建的稀疏任务.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of MapLightning . A shared image backbone encodes each of the C C camera views over T T timesteps into image tokens, which are flattened and augmented with learned positional, camera, and time embeddings. Instead of projecting these tokens into a dense BEV grid, we concatenate them with K K learnable map tokens and jointly refine both with a self-attention mapper (Figure 1 (c)), without camera parameters or depth. The image tokens are then discarded, and the compact map tokens serve as the scene representation, which task-specific decoders attend to with full cross-attention. Beyond online vectorized HD map construction, this representation supports 3D object detection and downstream trajectory prediction from the predicted maps.
blocks.zh: 图2:地图照明概况. 一个共享的图像主干线将C C 相机在 T T 时间步上的每个视图编码为图像符,通过学习位置,相机,和时间嵌入来平整和增强. 我们不把这些符号投射到密集的BEV网格中,而是用KK可学习的地图符号来组装它们,并用一个自觉的映射仪(图1(c))共同精炼,没有摄像参数或深度. 然后丢弃图像代号,紧凑的地图代号作为场景代表,任务特定的解码器全程关注. 除了在线矢量化的HD地图构建外,这种表示支持从预测的地图中进行3D物体检测和下游轨迹预测.

blocks.en: Section 3.1 reviews the standard BEV-based approach to online vectorized HD map construction. We then describe our modifications: flat image-token embeddings (Section 3.2 ), a self-attention mapper that produces compact map tokens (Section 3.3 ), and the map decoder (Section 3.4 ). Figure 2 shows the architecture of MapLightning.
blocks.zh: 第3.1节审查了基于BEV的标准在线矢量HD地图构建方法. 然后,我们描述我们的修改:平面图像嵌入(第3.2节)、制作紧凑地图符号的自觉绘图器(第3.3节)和地图解码器(第3.4节)。 图2显示了MapLightning的架构.

blocks.en: 3.1 Background
blocks.zh: 3.1 背景情况

blocks.en: We retain the decoder architecture of MapTRv2 ( Liao et al., 2025 ) , including its L d = 6 L_{d}=6 layers. This change affects the decoder in two ways. First, since 𝐔 \mathbf{U} has no fixed 2D coordinates, deformable attention, which samples features around BEV reference points, no longer applies. blocks.en: Prediction head. We retain MapTRv2’s iterative coordinate refinement. Initial reference points are predicted from the decoder queries via a linear projection and sigmoid. At each layer, the regression branch predicts offsets that refine the current reference points for the next layer, while the classification branch predicts the class of each map element. Unlike MapTRv2, these reference points serve only for coordinate regression, not feature sampling. The final normalized coordinates are converted to metric positions as described in Section 3.1 , and predictions from all L d L_{d} layers are supervised.
blocks.zh: 预言头. 我们保留MapTRv2的迭代坐标改进。 初始参考点通过线性投影和sigmoid从解码器查询中预测. 在每个层,回归分支预测会抵消完善下层当前参考点,而分类分支预测每个映射元素的类别. 与MapTRv2不同,这些参考点只用于坐标回归,而不是特征采样. 如第3.1节所述,最后的正常化坐标将转换为度量位,并监督所有L d L_{d}层的预测。

blocks.en: Efficiency. Our mapper and decoder use standard attention and MLP operations, so all attention layers run with FlashAttention ( Dao et al., 2022 ) , whose memory scales linearly with sequence length for both self- and cross-attention. Compute is quadratic in N + K N+K , but confined to the L = 4 L=4 mapper layers, where runtime is largely bound by memory access rather than FLOPs. Following prior work ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , we cache past-frame features, so only the current frame is encoded. Our model runs at 18.9 FPS on nuScenes (Table 2 ), faster than MapTRv2’s dense BEV projection (14.1 FPS) and comparable to cross-attention (18.8 FPS). Breakdowns are in Appendix B.4 .
blocks.zh: 效率。 我们的映射器和解码器使用标准的注意和MLP操作,因此所有注意层都以FlashAttenty(Dao等人,2022年)运行,其内存尺度呈线性,既具有自留心又具有跨留心的序列长度. 计算在N + K N + K 中为四进制,但仅限于 L = 4 L = 4 映射层,其中运行时间主要受内存访问而不是FLOP的约束. 继先前的工作(Chen et al., 2024)之后,我们缓存了过去帧的特性,所以只有当前帧被编码. 我们的模型在nuScenes上运行于18.9 FPS(表2),比MapTRv2的密集BEV投影(14.1 FPS)快,与交叉投影(18.8 FPS)相当. 细目见附录B.4。

blocks.en: Dataset Splits. To rigorously evaluate generalization and avoid geographic data leakage, we adopt the Near-Extrapolation split ( Lilja et al., 2024 ) with a 60m × \times 30m perception range as our default benchmark for both nuScenes and Argoverse 2, following recent protocols ( Löwens et al., 2025 ; Lyu et al., 2025 ) . The original splits of nuScenes and Argoverse 2 suffer from severe train–val overlap (79.4% and 45.0%, respectively). While the StreamMapNet split ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) reduces nuScenes overlap to 2.1%, the Near-Extrapolation split minimizes it to 0.9% (within 5 m) for nuScenes (see Appendix D for visualizations) and 0% for Argoverse 2. For completeness, we also report improvements on the original and StreamMapNet splits in Appendix B.1 . For 3D object detection, we follow standard practice and use the original nuScenes split, since geographic overlap is less problematic for dynamic objects than for static HD map elements that persist across traversals.

blocks.en: Metrics. We report mean Average Precision (mAP) based on Chamfer distance, with thresholds of {0.5, 1.0, 1.5} m. Following prior work ( Liao et al., 2022 ; Liao et al., 2025 ) , runtime for all methods is reported in frames per second (FPS) on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 for a fair comparison. Best results overall are bolded , and the best results among prior methods are underlined .
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 我们报告指以Chamfer距离为基础的平均精度,阈值为{0.5、1.0、1.5}米。 继先前的工作(廖等人,2022年;廖等人,2025年)之后,所有方法的运行时间以每秒帧(FPS)报告在NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090上,以进行公平比较. 总体而言,最佳成果是大胆的,以往方法中的最佳成果是强调的。

blocks.en: Baselines. For online vectorized HD map construction, we benchmark against methods with public codebases, including MapTR ( Liao et al., 2022 ) , StreamMapNet ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) , MapTracker ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , MapTRv2 ( Liao et al., 2025 ) , DAMap ( Dong et al., 2025 ) , and AugMapNet ( Monninger et al., 2026 ) , and retrain each on the Near-Extrapolation split using its official code. VectorMapNet ( Liu et al., 2023b ) results are taken from ( Liu et al., 2023b ; Lilja et al., 2024 ) because no official implementation is available. SparseMeXt ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) , the closest prior work to ours in removing dense BEV, is excluded from our main comparisons because its code is unavailable and it reports no results on the Near-Extrapolation or StreamMapNet splits; we list its original-split result (100 epochs) in Appendix B.1 for reference. For 3D object detection, we report baseline results from their respective papers. We use ResNet-50 ( He et al., 2016 ) as the default image backbone for both map construction and object detection.
blocks.zh: 基线。 关于在线矢量HD地图的构建,我们参照有公共代码库的方法制定基准,包括MapTR(廖等人,2022年),StreamMapNet(袁等人,2024年),MapTracker。 (Chen et al.,2024),MapTRv2 (Liao et al.,2025),DAMap (Dong et al.,2025),和AugMapNet (Monninger et al.,2026),并各自使用其官方代码在近外分解上进行再培训. blocks.en: Figure 3: Image-to-image attention in the self-attention mapper. We select one image token as the query (magenta cross) and visualize its attention scores over the other image tokens, which serve as keys (red: high, blue: low), at the first and last ( L = 4 L=4 ) mapper layers. blocks.en: While MapUncertainty ( Gu et al., 2024 ) reports negligible impact on the original split, adding the uncertainty head reduces mAP for all methods on the Near-Extrapolation split ( Lilja et al., 2024 ) , possibly because NLL down-weights gradients for poorly predicted, high-variance samples ( Seitzer et al., 2022 ) . Comparing Tables 2 and 3 , our method degrades the least: -3.0 and -2.9 mAP for our cross- and self-attention variants, versus -6.8 , -15.2 , and -8.7 mAP for MapTR, StreamMapNet, and MapTRv2. Although the uncertainty head slightly reduces our map construction accuracy, it enables uncertainty-aware downstream trajectory prediction ( Zhou et al., 2022 ) .

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We proposed MapLightning, which replaces the dense 2D BEV grid with compact 1D learnable map tokens as the intermediate scene representation. Our mapper concatenates map and image tokens, applies self-attention, discards the image tokens, and retains the updated map tokens for decoding. This representation uses far fewer tokens, consumes less memory, runs faster, enables full cross-attention for global context, and avoids dependence on camera projection parameters. MapLightning achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and efficiency on nuScenes and Argoverse 2, and generalizes to uncertainty-aware map construction, downstream trajectory prediction, and 3D object detection.
blocks.zh: 我们提出MapLightning,它用紧凑的1D可学习地图符号取代密集的2D BEV网格作为中间场景代表. 我们的映像师将映像符和映像符混为一谈,应用了自觉,丢弃了映像符,保留了更新的映像符用于解码. 这种表示方式使用更少的符号,消耗更少的内存,运行速度更快,能够全方位交叉关注全球背景,避免依赖相机投影参数. MapLightning在nuScenes和Argoverse 2上实现了最先进的精度和效率,并概括到对不确定性认识的地图构造,下游轨迹预测,以及3D物体探测.

blocks.en: Limitations. (i) Replacing dense BEV features with compact 1D tokens may require additional adaptation in end-to-end frameworks, whose task decoders rely explicitly on the BEV grid structure (e.g., MapFormer and OccFormer in UniAD ( Hu et al., 2023 ) ). (ii) Our fixed token budget may require tuning for other tasks or datasets, and dynamic token selection ( Rao et al., 2021 ; Fayyaz et al., 2022 ; Yin et al., 2022 ) is a promising direction for adapting the budget to input complexity.
blocks.zh: 限制。 (一)用紧凑的1D令牌取代密集的BEV特征可能需要在端到端框架中进行额外的调整,其任务解码器明确依赖于BEV网格结构(如UniAD中的MapFormer和OccFormer(Hu等人,2023年)). (二)我们的固定令牌预算可能需要调整其他任务或数据集,动态令牌选择(Rao等人,2021年;Fayyaz等人,2022年;Yin等人,2022年)是使预算适应输入复杂性的有希望的方向.

blocks.en: Ablation on Token Count and Mapper Depth. Table 11 examines the effect of token count and mapper depth on accuracy. Increasing the number of tokens from 0.9k to 1.2k improves accuracy, but further increasing to 1.5k degrades it, possibly due to increasing redundancy among 1D map tokens. Varying the mapper depth shows a similar pattern: a depth of 3 is insufficient, while a depth of 5 slightly degrades accuracy, consistent with prior observations that transformers can exhibit diminishing returns as attention representations become increasingly redundant ( Zhou et al., 2021 ) . Our final configuration of 1.2k tokens and a mapper depth of 4 therefore offers the best accuracy among the settings tested, with FPS remaining nearly constant across all configurations.
blocks.zh: 关于托肯伯爵和地图人深度的注释. 表11审查了信物计数和绘图器深度对准确性的影响。 将信使数量从0.9k增加到1.2k提高了精度,但进一步增加到1.5k使其降解,这可能是由于1D地图信使的冗余增加. 不同的映射深度呈现出类似的模式:3的深度不足,而5的深度略微降低精度,这与先前的观察一致,即随着注意力表达变得日益冗余,变压器可以呈现递减的回报(周等人,2021年). 因此,我们最终配置的1.2k令牌和4的映射深度为测试的设置提供了最佳的准确性,所有配置的FPS几乎保持不变。

blocks.en: Ablation on Timesteps. Table 11 also shows that accuracy improves consistently up to 4 timesteps and slightly degrades at 6, making 4 timesteps the best-performing setting. This observation is consistent with MemFusionMap ( Song et al., 2025 ) , which conjectures that excessive temporal fusion dilutes the current-frame feature, and MambaMap ( Yang et al., 2025b ) , which conjectures that an excessively long memory window introduces redundancy and noise.
blocks.zh: 时光台阶上的错位. 表11还显示,准确性持续提高,达到4个时步,6时略有下降,使4个时步成为表现最好的环境。 这种观察符合MemFusionMap(Song等人,2025年)的推测,认为过长的时间聚变稀释了当前框架特征,而MambaMap(Yang等人,2025b年)的推测,认为过长的内存窗口引入冗余和噪音.

blocks.en: Appendix E Robustness to Camera Extrinsic Perturbations
blocks.zh: 附 录 E 摄像头的强性

blocks.en: In real-world deployment, camera intrinsics are generally stable, while camera extrinsic parameters may be affected by calibration errors ( Liao et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . Following MapTRv2 ( Liao et al., 2025 ) , we evaluate robustness to camera extrinsic perturbations by independently adding zero-mean Gaussian noise with varying standard deviations to the rotation and translation components of the camera extrinsics. Results are reported in Figure 8 , where our method shows no degradation, maintaining 35.3 mAP on nuScenes and 63.3 mAP on Argoverse 2 across all perturbation levels, as it does not explicitly rely on camera extrinsics. In contrast, under the largest perturbations, Dense BEV Projection drops from 26.7 mAP to 12.8 under rotation and 7.5 under translation on nuScenes, and from 53.1 mAP to 28.4 under rotation and 23.5 under translation on Argoverse 2.
blocks.zh: 在现实世界的部署中,相机内在性能一般稳定,而相机外部参数可能受到校准误差的影响(廖等人,2025年;王等人,2025年). MapTRv2 (廖等人,2025年)之后,我们通过独立添加零度高斯音,对相机外部的旋转和翻译组件进行标准偏差不同的标准偏差,来评价相机外部扰动的强度. 图8报告了结果,其中我们的方法显示没有降解,在所有扰动水平上保持35.3 mAP在nuScenes上,63.3 mAP在Argoverse 2上,因为它没有明确依赖摄像头。 相比之下,在最大的扰动下,Dense BEV Projection在旋转中从26.7 mAP下降到12.8,在nuScenes上从翻译7.5,在旋转中从53.1 mAP下降到28.4,在Argoverse上从翻译23.5 2. 国家

blocks.en: For both online vectorized HD map construction and 3D object detection, we replace the original BEV projection modules with our self-attention mapper and use full instead of deformable cross-attention in the decoder. Unlike the single-frame MapTRv2 ( Liao et al., 2025 ) setting, we use T = 4 T=4 timesteps and 50 map tokens per camera per timestep, yielding 1.2k map tokens for nuScenes (6 cameras) and 1.4k for Argoverse 2 (7 cameras).

blocks.en: F.1 Online Vectorized HD Map Construction
blocks.zh: F.1 在线矢量HD地图建设

blocks.en: We mainly follow the MapTRv2 ( Liao et al., 2025 ) framework and training settings, with ImageNet-pretrained ( Deng et al., 2009 ) image backbones and color-jitter augmentation. Input images are resized by a factor of 0.5 on nuScenes (1600 × \times 900 to 800 × \times 450) and, after padding to 2048 × \times 2048, by a factor of 0.3 on Argoverse 2. The decoder uses 50 instance queries, 20 point queries per element, and 6 layers, with classification, point, and direction loss weights of 2, 5, and 0.005. We remove MapTRv2’s depth, BEV segmentation, and PV segmentation auxiliary losses, since our mapper involves no depth estimation or BEV grid, and retain its one-to-many matching branch (300 extra instance queries, ground truth repeated 6 times). We train with AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2017 ) with a weight decay of 0.01 and a batch size of 4 per GPU on 8 NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPUs for 24 epochs on nuScenes and 6 epochs on Argoverse 2, with an initial learning rate of 6 × 10 − 4 6\times 10^{-4} and cosine decay. Adjacent input frames are 0.5 s apart on nuScenes and 0.4 s apart on Argoverse 2.

blocks.en: F.2 3D Object Detection
blocks.zh: F.2 3D 物体探测

blocks.en: We mainly follow the BEVFormer v2 ( Yang et al., 2023 ) framework and training settings on nuScenes, including COCO-pretrained ( Lin et al., 2014 ) backbone initialization and image-level data augmentation, with a ResNet-50 backbone and a 6-layer detection decoder. Unlike BEVFormer v2, which also fuses future frames and uses first-stage perspective proposals as hybrid object queries, we use only past frames (4-frame input, adjacent frames 0.5 s apart) and learned object queries. For easier comparison with prior work ( Li et al., 2023b ; Lin et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023a ; Han et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024a ; Su et al., 2025 ; Fan et al., 2026 ) , we use an input resolution of 256 × \times 704. We train for 24 epochs on 8 NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPUs with a batch size of 2 per GPU using AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2017 ) with a weight decay of 0.01, an initial learning rate of 4 × 10 − 4 4\times 10^{-4} , and an image-backbone learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} .
